reviews.conclusion: Pause/settings menus directly visible in 2 separate visits. Their combined proxy transition bounds are 0.50-1.50 s; the reported deficit is 1.533 s. Most of the intervening eye-view phase is severely resized/obscured, with unknown pause state. The menu upper bound is about 0.033 s below the deficit, below the proxy frame spacing; do not claim exact closure or a residual anomaly.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
